{{Top|leg}}
A '''flintlock''' was a type of [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]]. Some of these weapons were traded to [[Sebiri]] villagers on [[Sebiris]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteur]] known as [[the Wraith]]. The Sebiri could not shoot the weapons well, and often the noise from the weapon discharge startled the shooter.<ref name="TIOM">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Traitor in our Midst|book=The DarkStryder Campaign}}</ref> They were used in the [[Virgillia system/Legends|Virgillia system]] by the [[Virgillian Free Alignment/Legends|Virgillian Free Alignment]] against [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], as they did not have access to [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]].<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref>
